newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Alusuisse shares sag as market hopes dashed.
newsitem.headline: Alusuisse shares sag as market hopes dashed.

text.p: Shares of Alusuisse-Lonza Holding AG fell on the Swiss Exchange as the company's new strategy failed to live up to the market's hopes that it would spin-off one of its divisions or unify its shares.
"Speculative expectations were not fulfilled," Zurich Kantonalbank said in its daily research note.
At 0750 GMT Alusuisse's registered share was down 3.91 percent to 1,449 Swiss francs in a generally firmer market.
Ahead of today's news conference, which Alusuisse had called to elaborate on "further development of our stategy," shares in Alusuisse had been hotly traded.
After the news conference was called on June 18, the shares immediately jumped from a closing price of 1,442 francs on June 17 to a high of 1,517 on June 30.
